sections.label: Verse 1 · Long-line test
sections.primary:
When the morning finds us waiting with questions that we cannot answer, Your faithful presence gives us courage for the road ahead
When the evening leaves us weary from carrying the cares of others, Your gentle mercy makes a place where every heart can rest

sections.label: Chorus · Manual break test
sections.primary:
Hope for every morning
Peace for every night

Strength for every journey
Guide us in Your light
